content: Given an email, classify whether the sender is claimed to from the internal organization (e.g. colleague, boss, admin staff, subordinate, teacher, student, etc.) or external organization as the recipient. Answer 'A' if internal, answer 'B' if external, answer 'Unclear' if unsure. Do not give any explanation.
